summary: Zeo ScientifiX filed an 8-K reporting that its unaudited monthly sales surpassed $1 million in April 2026 for the first time. This is a routine operational milestone announcement, not a special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. No deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural changes were disclosed. The filing includes only a press release and standard cover page. There is no transaction, no activist campaign, no capital return, and no management change. The event is purely a commercial update with no implication of a corporate event. As such, this filing does not qualify for any special-situations category.
